scope_note: This 1923 correction prevents unconscious and repressed from being used as synonyms and prepares the shift beyond a purely topographical vocabulary.
statement: Freud stated in 1923 that the repressed formed a proper subset of the unconscious.
statement_zh: Freud 在 1923 年指出，被壓抑者只是無意識範圍中的一個真子集。
